import java.util.Scanner;

public class cf723b_variant1 {
    private static final Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);

    private static int[] analyzeDocument(String text) {
        boolean inParentheses = false;
        boolean previousWasLetter = false;
        int maxWordLength = 0;
        int currentWordLength = 0;
        int wordCountInParentheses = 0;

        for (int index = 0; index < text.length(); index++) {
            char currentChar = text.charAt(index);
            if (currentChar == '(') {
                inParentheses = true;
                previousWasLetter = false;
                currentWordLength = 0;
            } else if (currentChar == ')') {
                inParentheses = false;
                previousWasLetter = false;
                currentWordLength = 0;
            } else if (Character.isLetter(currentChar)) {
                if (inParentheses && !previousWasLetter) {
                    wordCountInParentheses++;
                } else if (!inParentheses) {
                    currentWordLength++;
                    if (currentWordLength > maxWordLength) {
                        maxWordLength = currentWordLength;
                    }
                }
                previousWasLetter = true;
            } else {
                previousWasLetter = false;
                currentWordLength = 0;
            }
        }

        return new int[]{maxWordLength, wordCountInParentheses};
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        String input = scanner.next();
        int[] result = analyzeDocument(input);
        System.out.println(result[0] + " " + result[1]);
    }
